defaultPolicy.ownerBoundary: All private app APIs must resolve owner context before reading or writing vault data.
defaultPolicy.authBaseline: Protected by middleware when REQUIRE_AUTH=true; local development may run without Clerk. Anonymous vaults require ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_VAULT=true.

scopePresets.read_only_assistant: Owner-scoped reads for people, context packs, queue summaries, stories, and documents.
scopePresets.capture_validate: Validate user-provided capture packages without saving or merging.
scopePresets.capture_merge: Merge user-provided capture packages after review.
scopePresets.research_operator: Create tasks and update checks with evidence-backed notes.
scopePresets.story_writer: Save story drafts inside an owner vault.
scopePresets.trusted_operator: Higher-risk merges, publish actions, and bulk operations.
scopePresets.admin_security: Cross-user, incident, or security workflows. Not present.

story_writer.notes: Can draft, edit, request review, and preview publish readiness. Cannot assign reviewers or publish public stories.

reviewer.notes: Can inspect and assign review work, including second-review requirements. Cannot publish public stories.

trusted_publisher.notes: Can publish only after publish gates, required second approval, and human review confirmation pass. Public stories stay noindex by default through publicIndexing.

routes.notes: Returns current internal capability actions for the requesting actor role. Story capabilities distinguish story_writer preview/draft access from trusted publisher public publish authority.

Human-managed agent API keys. POST mints a key: the raw secret is generated + SHA-256-hashed server-side and returned exactly once; only the hash is stored. GET lists the owner's keys and never returns the hash. Agents do not mint keys; this is a signed-in human route.
Revoke one of the owner's API keys (idempotent). Owner-guarded in the Convex mutation via matchesVaultOwner.
Write route; needs provenance and context validation before agent support.
Creates review-first person context items. AI use is denied unless the context is reviewed and non-private.
Sensitive derived artifacts.
Owner-scoped people explorer data.
Private vault metadata.
Use ?preview=true for side-effect-free validation. FamilySearch provider API access is pending; browser/user-initiated packages only.
Updates privacy, review, rights, AI-use, and review notes. AI use requires reviewed, non-private media with usable rights.
completionSource=ai_agent requires summary, notes, and confidence gates.
Promote/merge affects identity graph. Keep human-only until stronger gates exist.
Best first queue handoff surface after deterministic export.
Needs task-quality requirements before broad agent use.
Local artifact-backed bridge, not canonical people API.
Bridge across Convex and local artifacts.
Strongest future agent handoff read surface.
Mixed read/write document workflow documented in docs/api/legacy-document-route-boundary.md. Keep internal until method semantics are split.
GET may generate/sync artifacts as documented in docs/api/legacy-document-route-boundary.md. Keep internal until method semantics are split.
Sensitive source evidence.
Draft save is lower risk than publish but should keep provenance. Story writer scope can create or revise drafts, not publish.
High privacy/abuse/cost risk; no broad externalization without quotas and disclosure.
Owner-protected story edit. Story writer scope can change title/content/type/tags while preserving review workflow.
Assigns a reviewer, can require second approval for high-risk stories, and records an owner-scoped story review event. Explicit story_writer role is denied reviewer assignment.

GET returns publish readiness and optional format=handoff packet; use record=true to store a publish-preview audit snapshot. PATCH to published is blocked unless evidence, context, privacy/living-risk, provisional-relative, story-strength, review-status, and required second-approval gates pass plus explicit human review confirmation. Explicit story_writer role can preview/request review but is denied publish; trusted_operator/trusted publisher authority is required for agent publishing.

GEN-83. One-shot trigger: when an authenticated user still has the anonymous-vault preview cookie set, re-tags every owner-scoped row from the guest UUID to their Clerk user id and deletes the cookie. No-ops when not signed in, no cookie, or Clerk/Convex not configured. Convex mutation enforces a guest_* source prefix and user_* destination prefix as defense in depth. Never exposed to external agents.
